name: Groovy Palette & Frames
description: Thirty more COLORS palettes, eight text-box borders, and a day/night cycle that recolours the world as the hours pass -- by your real clock or by steps walked. Press A on OPTION -> COLORS to preview a palette on the running game. USE ADVANCED rides the engine per-tile colorization instead of replacing it, so a palette recolours eighteen colours on screen, not four.
